title: Overlap structure of mixed even $p$-spin models
summary: We identify the limiting overlap structure of mixed even $p$-spin models, including the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, at every fixed deterministic external field. In particular, we show that the disorder-averaged distribution of the overlap, or its absolute value at zero field, converges to the Parisi measure. We identify the full limiting array using the overlap array of the associated Ruelle probability cascade.
